title: MIDAS Lookup Entry
description: An entry (row) from a MIDAS lookup/reference table. All rows carry UploadCode and Description; some tables add extra columns (e.g. the Unit table adds PayloadDescriptor and UnitType), so additional properties are permitted.

UploadCode.description: The code used during rate uploads.

PayloadDescriptor.description: Optional machine token for the row (present on the Unit table, e.g. 'BACKUP_PRICE').

UnitType.description: Optional unit category (present on the Unit table, e.g. 'KWH').
